about.headline: I make things, in code, colour and fabric.
paragraphs: I'm Almuatasim Alfarsi, a Computer Science graduate from Middle East College in Muscat. I design and build interfaces, I draw and paint, I sew, and I build sets for art and fashion projects. To me it is all the same work: taking an idea and making it real, whether the material is code, colour or fabric.

In tech, I focus on UI/UX design and front-end development. In art, I make bold, cubism-influenced portraits, and I work with Omani artist Abdulaziz Al-Hosni as a set and fabrication artist, building, painting and sewing for projects with WeTransfer and Amouage.

Five years in customer service taught me to read people and notice what they need before they say it. I bring that to everything I make, so whoever uses it, wears it or stands in front of it feels it was made for them.

qalb.description: A photographic series by Abdulaziz Al-Hosni, commissioned by WeTransfer and published on WePresent, and shown at Melkweg Expo in Amsterdam in October 2024. estudioa.problem: Users searching for sewing patterns found keyword-only search frustrating: a typo or an unusual phrase turned up nothing.
estudioa.insight: A pattern-discovery platform needed natural-language, typo-tolerant search, built for three different people: the person looking for a pattern, the designer who made it, and the admin who moderates the library.
estudioa.build: Fuzzy search ("summer dress for beginners", typos allowed) and a recommendation score (category 0.3, difficulty 0.1, tags 0.3, semantic similarity 0.3), with User, Designer and Admin roles and a moderation workflow. Built solo across 6 Scrum sprints, shaped by a user survey, documented with UML, ERD and DFD.

apos.problem: At a cafe in a venue with three outlets (cafe, gift shop and ticketing), three disconnected POS systems ran side by side.
apos.insight: One multi-tenant platform, with screen sets tailored to each outlet, deterministic and auditable instead of black-box AI.
apos.build: PIN clock-in, Admin and Device modes, terminal pairing with device JWTs, roaming staff, void/refund approval chains, and company-wide cash rollup.
apos.liveNote: Opens the login screen. Demo access on request.

padelaura.problem: The practical exam for the Nahj training-to-employment programme: build a working booking platform in [[four days]].
padelaura.insight: Booking with only a phone number removes the sign-up wall that stops people booking a court on the spot.
padelaura.build: Smart random court allocation, tiered pricing, pay on arrival or online via Thawani, QR confirmations, an analytics dashboard, full Arabic and English.
padelaura.result: [[Placed 2nd]] in the Nahj programme, built in 4 days.

images.confirmation: PadelAura booking confirmation screen with QR code

papitoooo.insight: Not every project has to solve a problem. A browser photo booth for friends and family, for happy, unfiltered moments. Nothing leaves the device.
papitoooo.build: Themed frames (boarding pass, thermal receipt, music card, and original hand-drawn leopard-scallop and glitter-star frames) fit nine layouts using 9-slice compositing. Mobile Safari download and filter bugs solved. Arabic and English with RTL.
